en: I fought with a boy.
I didn't fight with my brother yesterday.
You fought with your friend in the street.

ar: علاش ما تدابزتيش مع داك الراجل
en: Why didn't you fight with that man?
You fought with your sister in the kitchen.
I knew that you didn't fight yesterday.
He fought with the neighbors' son today.

lat: ma tdabezsh f l-medrasa had s-sba7
en: He didn't fight at school this morning.
She fought with her cousin.
She didn't fight with her sister yesterday.
We fought over the ball.
We didn't fight with those people.
Did you fight in the café yesterday?
You (pl.) didn't fight with your teacher.
The boys fought in the courtyard.
They didn't fight because they understand each other.
I always fight with my little brother.
I don't fight with anyone.
You always fight with your friends.

ar: علاش ما كتتدابزش مع ولد عمك
en: Why don't you fight with your cousin?

lat: nti kattdabzi m3a khtek kul nhar
ar: نتي كتتدابزي مع ختك كل نهار
en: You fight with your sister every day.
Why don't you fight at school?

lat: huwa kaytdabez kul nhar f z-zenqa
en: He fights every day in the street.
He doesn't fight because he is gentle.
She fights a lot with her friend.

lat: hiya ma kattdabezsh m3a d-drari s-sghar
ar: هي ما كتتدابزش مع الدراري الصغار
en: She doesn't fight with young children.

lat: ba3d l-merrat kantdabzu ana w khuya
ar: بعض المرات كنتدابزو انا و خويا
en: Sometimes my brother and I fight.
We don't fight at home.
You (pl.) fight every day.

ar: علاش ما كتتدابزوش مع دوك الولاد
en: Why don't you fight with those boys?
The kids are fighting over the ball now.
They don't fight with the neighbors.

lat: ghadi ntdabez m3a dak l-weld ghedda
ar: غادي نتدابز مع داك الولد غدا
en: I am going to fight with that boy tomorrow.

ar: ما غاديش نتدابز مع حتى واحد
en: I am not going to fight with anyone.
Are you going to fight with him tomorrow?

lat: nta ma ghadish ttdabez m3a sahbek
ar: نتا ما غاديش تتدابز مع صاحبك
en: You are not going to fight with your friend.

lat: nti ghadi ttdabzi m3a khtek daba
ar: نتي غادي تتدابزي مع ختك دابا
en: You are going to fight with your sister now.

lat: nti ma ghadish ttdabzi f z-zenqa
en: You are not going to fight in the street.

ar: هو غادي يتدابز مع ولد عمو
en: He is going to fight with his cousin.
He is not going to fight today.

lat: hiya ghadi ttdabez m3a bent l-jiran
ar: هي غادي تتدابز مع بنت الجيران
en: She is going to fight with the neighbors' daughter.

lat: hiya ma ghadish ttdabez m3a khtha
ar: هي ما غاديش تتدابز مع ختها
en: She is not going to fight with her sister.

ar: حنا غادي نتدابزو مع دوك الرجال
en: We are going to fight with those men.
We are not going to fight in the market.
Are you going to fight now?

lat: ntuma ma ghadish ttdabzu m3a s7abkum
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تتدابزو مع صحابكم
en: You (pl.) are not going to fight with your friends.
The boys are going to fight in the forest.

lat: huma ma ghadish ytdabzu m3a l-bolis
ar: هما ما غاديش يتدابزو مع البوليس
en: They are not going to fight with the police.
